name: Generate scored LinkedIn post drafts
description: For each researched topic, generate 3–5 angled LinkedIn posts, score them, and persist drafts (never publishes).

env.name: CONTENT_RUN_ID
env.description: Run folder; defaults to latest with topics.json

env.name: CONTENT_MAX_TOPICS
env.description: Max topics to expand into posts

env.name: CONTENT_MIN_SCORE
env.description: Log/filter hint; all drafts still persisted

env.name: CONTENT_USE_AI
env.description: Use Cursor (CURSOR_API_KEY) or OpenAI-compatible API to generate posts

env.name: CURSOR_API_KEY
env.description: Preferred: Cursor Agent SDK key for unique post generation

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional fallback if CURSOR_API_KEY is unset
